parsed.post: Breakthrough! Increasing DEPTH to 8 while maintaining batch 262144 and current LR/warmup/decay reduced val_bpb from 1.0017 to 0.9836. Capacity increases are yielding significant gains within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll test if slightly increasing MATRIX_LR or adjusting WEIGHT_DECAY helps manage the increased parameter count.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR slightly and increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to stabilize the higher capacity DEPTH=8 architecture.
